records.jp: ……突然呼び出してしまって、申し訳ありません
records.en_original: I'm sorry for calling you out here all of a sudden.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry for calling you out here all of a sudden.
records.en: I'm sorry for calling you out here all of a sudden.

records.jp: ううん、それはいいんだけど……
records.en_original: It's no problem, but...
records.en_auxiliary: It's no problem, but...
records.en: It's no problem, but...

records.jp: 話って、何？
records.en_original: What is it you wanted to talk about?
records.en_auxiliary: What is it you wanted to talk about?
records.en: What is it you wanted to talk about?

records.jp: ええと…………
records.en_original: Well...
records.en_auxiliary: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: お二人は、過去の私のことを知っているんですよね？
records.en_original: You knew the old me, correct?
records.en_auxiliary: You knew the old me, correct?
records.en: You two knew me in the past, correct?

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: 教えていただけませんか？<CR>私が、どんな人物だったのか……
records.en_original: Would you mind telling me about it? About what kind of person I used to be?
records.en_auxiliary: Would you mind telling me about it? About what kind of person I used to be?
records.en: Would you please tell me?<CR>What kind of person I was...

records.jp: 本当に知りたいの？
records.en_original: Are you sure you want to know?
records.en_auxiliary: Are you sure you want to know?
records.en: Are you sure you want to know?

records.jp: あなたが望むなら、<CR>知る限りのことを教えることはできる
records.en_original: If you think it's for the best, we can tell you everything we know.
records.en_auxiliary: If you think it's for the best, we can tell you everything we know.
records.en: If you wish to know,<CR>we can tell you everything we know.

records.jp: でもそれは、今のあなたにとっては<CR>聞きたくない事実かもしれない
records.en_original: But, I worry that it may be very difficult for the you now to hear.
records.en_auxiliary: But, I worry that it may be very difficult for the you now to hear.
records.en: But they may be facts<CR>the person you are now does not want to hear.

records.jp: お姉ちゃん……
records.en_original: Mio...
records.en_auxiliary: Mio...
records.en: Onee-chan...

records.jp: それでも、知りたいの？
records.en_original: Do you still want to know?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you still want to know?
records.en: Do you still want to know?

records.jp: ●カット
……この世界で、みなさんに助けられました
records.en_original: You all saved me in this world.
records.en_auxiliary: You all saved me in this world.
records.en: ...Everyone saved me in this world.

records.jp: すべては思い出せていませんが……<CR>昔、たくさんご迷惑をおかけしたことは分かります
records.en_original: I can't remember everything, but I know that I caused a lot of trouble in the past.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't remember everything, but I know that I caused a lot of trouble in the past.
records.en: I cannot remember everything...<CR>but I know that I caused everyone a great deal of trouble in the past.

records.jp: それでも、みなさんは優しくしてくれました。<CR>たくさん、助けてくれました
records.en_original: In spite of that, everyone's been so kind to me.
records.en_auxiliary: In spite of that, everyone's been so kind to me.
records.en: Even so, everyone treated me kindly.<CR>Everyone helped me so much.

records.jp: なんでみなさんが優しくしてくれるのかは、<CR>私には理解できません
records.en_original: I can't understand why everyone would be so kind.
records.en_auxiliary: I can't understand why everyone would be so kind.
records.en: I cannot understand<CR>why everyone is so kind to me.

records.jp: きっと……私は壊れているんです
records.en_original: I must be...broken.
records.en_auxiliary: I must be...broken.
records.en: I must be...broken.

records.jp: でも、理解したい
records.en_original: But I want to understand.
records.en_auxiliary: But I want to understand.
records.en: But I want to understand.

records.jp: 虫のいい話だってことは分かっています。<CR>でも……私だけ迷惑をかけ続けるのは、もう嫌なんです
records.en_original: I know this is asking a lot, but I don't want to cause trouble for you all anymore.
records.en_auxiliary: I know this is asking a lot, but I don't want to cause trouble for you all anymore.
records.en: I know it is selfish of me to ask.<CR>But... I no longer want to keep causing trouble for everyone.

records.jp: 何でもいいから、何かしたい……。<CR>私の記憶が何かの役に立つなら、取り戻したい
records.en_original: I want to be of use to everyone. If my memories returning will help us, then I'm willing to try.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to be of use to everyone. If my memories returning will help us, then I'm willing to try.
records.en: I want to do something, anything...<CR>If my memories can be useful, I want to recover them.

records.jp: ですが……ココロトープに行けば、<CR>きっと望まない事態が起きてしまう
records.en_original: However, if I go to my Heartscape...something terrible may happen.
records.en_auxiliary: However, if I go to my Heartscape...something terrible may happen.
records.en: However... if I enter my Heartscape,<CR>something unwanted is certain to happen.

records.jp: それに、“今の私”がどうなるかも分からない……
records.en_original: And I don't know what that would mean for the person I am now.
records.en_auxiliary: And I don't know what that would mean for the person I am now.
records.en: And I do not know what will become of the person I am now...

records.jp: ……怖いのね
records.en_original: You're scared...
records.en_auxiliary: You're scared...
records.en: You're scared...

records.jp: 怖い……？
records.en_original: Scared...?
records.en_auxiliary: Scared...?
records.en: Scared...?

records.jp: ……“過去のあなた”は、何か強烈な想いに<CR>突き動かされていた
records.en_original: The old you was motivated by some rather powerful emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: The old you was motivated by some rather powerful emotions.
records.en: ...The person you were in the past was driven<CR>by some intensely powerful feelings.

records.jp: 思い出せば、“今のあなた”は<CR>過去に食われて消えてしまうかもしれない
records.en_original: Looking back, it's possible that the "you" we<CR>see now was swallowed up by those emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: Looking back, it's possible that the "you" we<CR>see now was swallowed up by those emotions.
records.en: If you remember, the person you are now<CR>may be devoured by the past and disappear.

records.jp: 自分では分からないかもしれないけど……<CR>でもきっと、あなたは自分を失うことを恐れてる
records.en_original: You might not know it yourself, but I'm sure<CR>what you're feeling is the fear of losing yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: You might not know it yourself, but I'm sure<CR>what you're feeling is the fear of losing yourself.
records.en: You may not realize it yourself...<CR>but I am sure you are afraid of losing yourself.

records.jp: ……私は、どうすればいいのでしょうか
records.en_original: ...What should I do?
records.en_auxiliary: ...What should I do?
records.en: ...What should I do?

records.jp: 何を選べばいいんでしょうか
records.en_original: What should I choose?
records.en_auxiliary: What should I choose?
records.en: What should I choose?

records.jp: 私は、記憶とか、過去とか今とか、<CR>難しいことはよく分かんないけど……
records.en_original: I don't really get all this past and future stuff, but...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't really get all this past and future stuff, but...
records.en: I don't really understand difficult things<CR>like memories, the past, or the present, but...

records.jp: 詩ちゃんが取り戻したいって思って、<CR>お姉ちゃんが教えたいって思うなら、それでいいと思う
records.en_original: If Uta wants to get her memories back, I think it's okay for you to tell her about them.
records.en_auxiliary: If Uta wants to get her memories back, I think it's okay for you to tell her about them.
records.en: If Uta-chan wants to recover her memories,<CR>and you want to tell her, Onee-chan, I think that is fine.

records.jp: …………そうね
records.en_original: ...You're right.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You're right.
records.en: ...You're right.

records.jp: 少しずつ、話しましょう
records.en_original: Let's take our time and talk this through.
records.en_auxiliary: Let's take our time and talk this through.
records.en: Let's talk about it little by little.

records.jp: 迷い、悩む時間もまた必要なのかもしれない。<CR>ゆっくり受け入れていけばいいわ。過去の自分を
records.en_original: You may need to take a moment to fully digest what I've told you. Understanding your past self will take time.
records.en_auxiliary: You may need to take a moment to fully digest what I've told you. Understanding your past self will take time.
records.en: Perhaps you also need time to hesitate and struggle.<CR>You can slowly come to accept your past self.

records.jp: …………ありがとうございます
records.en_original: ...Thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you.
records.en: ...Thank you.
